jobs.title: Software Engineer, Find My
jobs.description:
The Find My team is dedicated to building a seamless, private, and secure experience for users to locate their devices, personal items, and share location with friends and family. We're a group of highly motivated engineers, designers, and product managers who are passionate about creating a simple and reliable experience for hundreds of millions of users worldwide. We thrive in a fast paced environment where team members are often encouraged to wear multiple hats and contribute to various aspects of the product lifecycle. Innovation and creative problem-solving are at the heart of our team, and we constantly explore new approaches to deliver groundbreaking solutions while collaborating with diverse disciplines across the company, including hardware, software, and privacy, to deliver an exceptional user experience.  
  
**Description**  
  
As an engineer on our team, you'll thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like environment, collaborating closely with a passionate team to achieve a shared mission. You'll be instrumental in developing exciting new features, and your contributions will directly impact millions of users. We embrace continuous iteration and improvement, so you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and refine your skills as we build the future of Find My.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Knowledge of web programming languages like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery  
  
Familiarity with developing machine learning systems, ML frameworks, libraries and algorithms is desirable but not required.  
  
Familiarity with GitHub, build and deployment tools like Maven, Docker, Spinnaker, Kubernetes  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
5+ years of validated programming experience  
  
Ability to be in office Monday through Thursday  
  
Strong Java expertise - including but not limited to: Core Java, Multithreading, non-blocking IO  
  
Shown working experience in all aspects of building customer facing Web services; most importantly authentication, authorization, scaling, availability, spam control and reliability  
  
Strong knowledge of using data storage and caching technologies like Cassandra, Redis and memcached or similar  
  
Strong in Java Performance Tuning, scaling Web Services and API definition  
  
Working knowledge of cryptography standards and protocols (e.g.. PKCS, KMIP, X.509, AES, KDF, CA)  
  
Experience writing REST based services using Netty or similar frameworks  
  
Knowledge and experience working with CI/CD tools integration/operations, and full automation testing  
  
Excellent analytical and problem solving skills  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills  
  
Ability to thrive in a multi-functional team on high-profile, critical projects  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Computer Vision/Deep Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Want to ship amazing experiences in Apple products? Be part of the team in the Video Computer Vision (VCV) organization that focuses on people understanding from real-time video streams and building higher level reasoning algorithms. VCV delivered biometric features such as Face ID and Optic ID as well as many other computer vision algorithms powering Apple Vision Pro, iPhone, and iPad. We focus on a balance of research and development to deliver Apple quality, state-of-the-art experiences. Come shape Apple products as a driven and dedicated Computer Vision/Deep Learning Algorithm Engineer to push the limits of biometric ML algorithms with hands-on work and real world and simulated data, in an innovative team and be part of building the next big thing.  
  
**Description**  
  
As a CV/ML engineer, you will develop new technologies for Apple’s next generation products. The focus will be innovating and delivering effective, efficient and well-tested computer vision based solutions from prototyping to shipping that are often deployed on edge devices. Besides domain expertise and technical knowledge the ideal candidate will possess the self-motivation, curiosity, and initiative to achieve those goals. Analogously, the candidate is a lifelong learner who passionately seeks to improve themselves and the quality of their work. You will work together with similar minds in an outstanding team where your skills and expertise can be used to influence future user experiences and hardware that will be used by millions.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience in object detection, vision transformers and multimodal networks.  
  
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.  
  
Creativity and curiosity for solving highly complex problems.  
  
Experience in biometrics, face tracking, gaze tracking, classical image processing, or computer vision.  
  
Familiarity with cloud technologies is a plus.  
  
MS or PhD in related field.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
Background in machine learning and deep learning.  
  
Proficiency in Python programming.  
  
Experience using ML frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch.  
  
BS and a minimum of 3 years of industry experience.  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $129,300 and $225,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

jobs.title: Bioinformatics Software Engineer III, OncoKB
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

  

**Exciting Opportunity at MSK:** The **Center for Molecular Oncology (CMO)** at **Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center** is seeking an innovative and highly skilled **Bioinformatics Software Engineer III** to help advance precision oncology through the development of software that supports ground breaking cancer genomics research and clinical care.

  
  

CMO's mission is to accelerate precision medicine by leveraging genomic analysis to improve cancer diagnosis, treatment, and patient outcomes. Bringing together clinicians, researchers, and computational scientists across MSK, the team leads large-scale translational research initiatives focused on uncovering the genomic drivers of cancer and their impact on clinical outcomes.

  
  

As a key member of the **OncoKB** team, you will contribute to one of the world's most trusted precision oncology knowledge bases. Recognized by the FDA and utilized globally by clinicians, researchers, and healthcare organizations, OncoKB powers real-time interpretation and annotation of cancer genomic alterations, supporting thousands of patient reports and research efforts each year.

  
  

In this role, you will collaborate closely with software engineers, bioinformaticians, scientists, and clinicians to design, build, and enhance scalable applications that support genomic data interpretation, knowledge curation, and clinical decision-making. You'll have the opportunity to work with modern technologies while helping shape the future of precision oncology.

  
  

This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer who is passionate about solving complex technical challenges and interested in applying their skills to meaningful work that directly impacts cancer research, clinical care, and patient outcomes worldwide!

  
  

**Role Overview:**
------------------

* Develop comprehensive system designs that support the scalability and evolution of the OncoKB platform.
* Partner closely with the Lead Software Engineer and multidisciplinary teams of software engineers, scientists, and clinicians.
* Design and enhance front-end and back-end applications that support genomic analysis, content curation, and clinical annotation workflows.
* Contribute to the continued growth of the OncoKB website, API, and underlying database infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex software challenges in a fast-paced environment.
* Mentor junior developers and promote engineering best practices across the team
  

  

**Key Qualifications** :

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Bioinformatics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience through a coding bootcamp and professional development.
* Minimum of 4 years of full-stack web development experience.
* Experience building and supporting production-level software applications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Interest in learning cancer biology, genomics, and precision medicine applications.  

**Core Skills:**

* JavaScript/TypeScript
* React, HTML, CSS
* Experience with one or more server-side technologies including Go, Java, C#, C++, or Python
* Relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL
* Git/GitHub or similar source control systems
* Full-stack application architecture and development
* Systems design and software troubleshooting
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with Docker and containerized application development
* Experience with Kubernetes and/or AWS cloud environments
* Coursework or professional experience in biology, genetics, genomics, or bioinformatics
* Interest in server-side rendered web development; experience with or willingness to learn Datastar
* Interest in Go development as the platform continues to evolve toward new Go-based services
  

  

**Additional Information** :

* Schedule: Hybrid, in office once a week, M-F, 37.5 hours
* Location: 323 E. 61st Street, NYC (Mackowe)
* Reporting to: Bioinformatics Software Engineer IV
  

  

The OncoKB software suite has been developed in-house at MSK since 2013. It includes a curation interface that supports content curation, a public website oncokb.org that hosts more than 1000 daily user visits worldwide, as well as a database and API that support real-time annotation of genomic variants identified in cancer patients. To better support clinical decisions and cancer research, we are looking to expand features of all OncoKB components.

Benefits

FSLA Status: Exempt
